sentences.en: On Friday I go to the market.

sentences.ar: בשוק יש ירקות, פירות ולחם טרי.
sentences.en: At the market there are vegetables, fruit and fresh bread.
The seller shouts about his tomatoes.
I buy tomatoes, cucumbers and bread.

sentences.ar: אני חוזר הביתה עם שקיות כבדות.
sentences.en: I go home with heavy bags.
